name: cwd-path
description: Shows the directory Claude Code is working in at the bottom right of the prompt footer.

maxLength.title: Maximum path length
maxLength.description: Longer paths are cut from the left, keeping the end of the path.

showBranch.title: Show the git branch
showBranch.description: Show the current git branch in parentheses after the path, when the directory is in a git repository.

shortenHome.title: Show the home folder as ~
shortenHome.description: Replace your home directory at the start of the path with ~.
